title: pedicularis wallichiana
intro: Pedicularis wallichiana, commonly known as the Himalayan lousewort or Indian lousewort, is a type of flowering plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis wallichiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can help in alleviating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
